description: A large stepped stone pyramid with a steep central staircase and a temple on top, with two carved feathered-serpent heads flanking the base of the stairs. Crowds of people in plain ancient-style dress fill a dusty plaza below, with thatched huts at the edges. Dramatic storm clouds with sunbeams break over the scene, and there is a distant treeline. The painting is edge to edge with no visible text, frame or border.
